scope: End-to-end run of the m1+m2 happy path on a synthetic thesis: init (ed25519 key + key card), background watch capturing four saves (700ms demo debounce; default 5s), log timeline, receipt export (.dpb + printable HTML), offline verify PASS, one-snapshot content_hash tamper, offline verify FAIL with breakpoint localization. All cryptography is real; the thesis text is synthetic.

tests: go test ./... — ok (cmd, internal/chain, internal/store, internal/report), includes fsnotify integration test and end-to-end init->capture->export->verify->tamper->FAIL test
limitations: Demo uses --debounce 700ms to keep the GIF short; shipped default is 5s.
The thesis file and its saves are synthetic; no real submission or detector was involved.
PASS means the package is intact since export and matches the pre-registered key fingerprint; it is not proof that no AI was used and not a third-party timestamp.
Receipts contain hashes and metadata only; the demo thesis never leaves the machine.
